key.name: categories
key.description: Empty means factory defaults. Each category has an ID, name, metadata matches, explicit inclusions and exclusions, and enabled state.

key.name: sort-order
key.description: Alphabetical, most frequently used according to GNOME, or most recently discovered installed apps first.

key.name: app-first-seen
key.description: JSON map of desktop app IDs to first-seen timestamps. Existing apps start with an unknown-date baseline of zero.

key.name: tab-opacity
key.description: Opacity percentage for the category ovals. Zero is transparent, 100 is opaque. Labels and keyboard focus indicators remain visible.
